ratchet_dock_worker: Grizzik, dock crew. This is Ratchet - Steamwheedle port, neutral ground. Ships in, goods out, coin changes hands. The boat at the east pier runs to Booty Bay.
ratchet_sailor: Pete. Neutral port, they call it. Neutral just means everybody's watching everybody, and the goblins are charging both sides for the view.
ratchet_merchant: Fizzle Brassbolt, general goods. Everything has a price in Ratchet. Everything. Yours is on the tag.
ratchet_fishmonger: Gribble. Fresh catch, fresher prices! Well - fresh catch. I also buy raptor hide for the dock crews' gloves, and the raptors out on the plain are not parting with it willingly.
ratchet_smuggler: Fintan. I move crates through the west gate and I don't know what's in them. I never ask. Long career, built entirely on never asking. Somebody in this town has started answering anyway.
ratchet_dock_laborer: Hask. I unload for the Steamwheedle docks - ships don't empty themselves, and my back's had enough. If you want to hear something worth a drink, ask Barnacle Bill what he saw out in the Barrens.
ratchet_bounty_hunter: Drask. Bounty hunter. Neutral port means neutral money - I'll take a contract from either side, or both. Right now the open one is a Southsea captain working the coast north of town.
ratchet_drunk_sailor: Bill. Barnacle Bill. My ship left without me. Again. Third time this month, I think. Or this week. I'll bet you a round I can tell you something about the Barrens you won't believe.
ratchet_customs_officer: Customs Officer Prynn, Steamwheedle Cartel. Neutral ground, official rules: declare your cargo or don't, I get paid either way. What I don't get paid for is pirates on the Merchant Coast taking it before it lands.
ratchet_goblin_child: I'm gonna build a boat that goes faster than the zeppelin! Uncle Gazlowe says I'm not allowed near the engines again. He didn't say anything about boilers.
ratchet_human_expat: Delia Thorne. Stormwind's politics got old, so I left. Ratchet's simpler - nobody here cares whose side you were on, only whether you can pay.
ratchet_troll_dockhand: Zulraka. I work da run between da Echo Isles and Ratchet, every week. Good pay for a strong back - when da pay shows up, and when somebody don't take a toll out of it first.
ratchet_gazlowe: Gazlowe. I run Ratchet for the Steamwheedle Cartel, which means every ship, crate and argument in this port ends up on my desk. Everything's for sale, friend. Even the things that aren't.
ratchet_flight_master: Zibb. Fastest wyvern in the harbour - cheap, too, if you don't count the screaming. I fly to anywhere you've been on foot.
ct_ratchet: Wrenchy. I train every discipline in Ratchet, for cash, in advance. Show me where you've got to.
pt_ratchet_forge: Fizzbolt. Mining and smithing. Ratchet's forge is at the north-west end of town; I teach here because the rent's lower.
pt_ratchet_herbs: Gadget, apothecary. Herbalism and alchemy. Anything that grows, I'll show you how to bottle - and anything you bottle in Ratchet, somebody will buy.
pt_ratchet_wood: Tinkle. Woodcutting and woodworking. Ships eat planks, so the Cartel pays well for both. The sawmill's up at the north-west end, by the forge.
pt_ratchet_hide: Snicker, tanner. Skinning, leatherworking, tailoring, cooking - one fee, four trades. That's a Ratchet bargain, and you won't hear me say that twice.
pt_ratchet_essence: Sprocket. Engineering - the only trade worth learning, and Ratchet's the only town worth learning it in. Metal, a crystal out of a vein, and try not to stand directly over it.
